text:
emma.p: Heads up — customer (FinBank) just failed PO ingestion from GCP marketplace. They attached a signed bundle as a .zip via DocuSign and portal returned a 422 on attachment hash mismatch. :grimacing:
rachel.s: ugh. FinBank is insisting on the DocuSign ZIP workflow for their procurement team, says legal/finance won't accept single PDFs. Any quick workaround?
tony.ops: what exactly did the portal log say? can you paste the error?
emma.p: here — marketplace returned: `400 Bad Request {\"error\":\"attachment_hash_mismatch\",\"detail\":\"expected 9f2b..., got 27a1...\"}`
lucy.eng: that error usually means the gateway computed a different checksum after the multipart unpacking step. we saw a similar one last year with nested zips + signed envelopes.
manual note: pasted the failing curl we used: ```curl -X POST https://marketplace.redwood.ai/v1/purchase_orders -F 'po=@po.zip' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'```
maya.ops: marketplace-bot shows recent change in the unzip library on 2026-02-18, commit id `c3f2b1` — it moved from streaming unzip to in-memory, might alter content normalization.
marketplace-bot: @channel deploy 2026-02-18 libunzip upgrade (c3f2b1) — note: relaxed filename normalization, potential effects on binary signature payloads.
anil.legal: if the DocuSign ZIP contents are byte-for-byte altered we may have a compliance/regulatory issue for customers requiring original signed bytes. we need to preserve the original envelope as-is or give a documented workaround.
rachel.s: customer expects a resolution within 24h or they'll pause the marketplace purchase. sales is on standby.
tony.ops: short-term workaround: ask procurement to upload the raw signed PDFs (one per document) instead of the DocuSign zip. can we accept multiple attachments per PO?
lucy.eng: yes portal accepts multiple files, but UI/ingestion on their side may be slower. downside: breaks FinBank internal process.
emma.p: asked them if they can do that — they're pushing back. can we implement a passthrough mode to preserve raw bytes for zips? estimate?
lucy.eng: rough estimate: 1 engineer 2 days to add a `preserve_blob` flag that skips normalization and streams the archived bytes into storage. need security review for streaming large blobs.
may_ops: ops: risk of disk/ram spikes; need quotas. also have to add a safety validation to avoid zip bombs.
anil.legal: also need to log consent and store audit trail if we bypass normalization. fine if documented and customer accepts terms.
tony.ops: operationally we can patch a canary route today to accept FinBank's uploads and route to preserve_blob. but we need eng + legal + product signoff.
rachel.s: ok i'll escalate in the customer call and get a signed acceptance to do the canary fallback. can you draft the consent language, @anil.legal?
anil.legal: will draft short ACK: "By opting into raw-blob ingestion the customer acknowledges that Redwood will ingest and store original signed artifacts without normalization for the purpose of PO acceptance; customer is responsible for verifying signatures." will send in dm.
lucy.eng: timeline if greenlit: canary PR today, deploy to staging tomorrow, prod canary within 24-36h.
marketplace-bot: created ticket MP-5829 "preserve-zip-bytes-canary" assigned to @lucy.eng.
emma.p: thanks all. rachel, pls share customer acceptance ASAP. i'll coordinate with eng/ops for canary traffic. :thumbsup:
rachel.s: on the call now, pushing for acceptance. will update thread in 30m. :phone:
